# Bus 1 (Slack)
IEEE 14 bus 1, 135kV, slack, vm 1.06 pu, connected to lines 1-2,1-5, gen slack

# Line 1-2
From bus 1 to 2, 135kV, rating 3% loading (tuned), type ol, critical corridor; outage drives 2.37% loading on line_1_5

# Line 9-14
Weak line, outage drops bus14 to 0.9425 pu, E6 ladder target

# Generator G2 @ bus2
Pmax 140MW, vm 1.02 pu, type synchronous, outage tested E4

# BESS @ bus9
20MW/40MWh SOC 10-90% eta 0.95, cid gen_BESS9, max discharge depends on SOC

# Voltage Limits
Min 0.94 pu, max 1.05 pu (slack 1.06), violations flagged by Stage8

# Thermal Limits
Line 3% trafo 4% (tuned from 100% to make IEEE14 stressed), overload >limit

# Contingency Procedure
If overload or undervoltage, run power_flow then contingency then OPF; pattern C requires low SOC check
